CZN_ACTION_COUNT_POWER.title: Action Count
CZN_ACTION_COUNT_POWER.description: Whenever {Amount} cards are played, this creature immediately takes its turn.
POLEMICA_BROOD_POWER.title: Hatching Ritual
POLEMICA_BROOD_POWER.description: Polemica's ritual count increases by 1 each time she acts. At 3, her next action executes all summonses and calls a new wave.
SERAPHION_HALF_DEATH_POWER.title: Half-Death Undying
SERAPHION_HALF_DEATH_POWER.description: While Arkrus lives, Seraphion's HP cannot reach 0: the loss is intercepted at 1 HP, and from then on it enters a dying state in which it takes no HP loss and can no longer be targeted. Arkrus' Rescue Hymn can raise it; when Arkrus dies, the dying Seraphion perishes with it.
AGNES_RESONANCE_POWER.title: Resonance
AGNES_RESONANCE_POWER.description:
Resonance is Agnes' pressure gauge: she gains 3 stacks when she transforms, then 2 more for each charging move, up to 10.
[gold]Execution[/gold] consumes all Resonance: damage = base × (1 + Resonance + 2 × shards on the field), after which she regains 3 stacks. Each Echo Shard on the field also increases [gold]Execution[/gold] damage.
